title: SweetBerry Sans
description: Adds a compact, sans serif font that I made on a whim.
body:
A compact, sans serif typeface that I made on a whim. Supports ascii, IGA, IPA, and accented characters. Modifies some non-latin european characters. Adds a light gradient to all characters (at least when they aren't coloured black). Here is a demo of the font (more can be found in the gallery):

![A demonstration of the font in a book and quill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a22af51639ac6299eeda9a5b066f1227c6c9863.png)
